Every Japanese string of the tags and the command line is listed beside its English in `docs/strings-ja.md`. The tiles' names are in `src/names.ts` (the Japanese ones are `faceWordsJa`), the layouts' names are in `src/cliWords.ts` (`LAYOUT_NAMES_JA`) and the demo page's own words are in `demo/words.js` (`WORDS.ja`, beside `WORDS.en`).
